@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import os
+from requests.utils import get_netrc_auth
+
+# Set NETRC environment variable to point to the .netrc file in the current directory
+os.environ["NETRC"] = os.path.abspath(".netrc")
+
+# Test case 1: Valid login
+with open(".netrc", "w") as f:
+    f.write("host: example.com\n    login:myuser\n    password:mypassword\n")
+print(f"Test 1 (login): {get_netrc_auth('http://example.com')}")
+# Expected: ('myuser', 'mypassword')
+
+# Test case 2: Valid account
+with open(".netrc", "w") as f:
+    f.write("host: example.com\n    :myaccount\n    :mypassword\n")
+print(f"Test 2 (account): {get_netrc_auth('http://example.com')}")
+# Expected: ('myaccount', 'mypassword')
+
+# Test case 3: Empty entry (should be ignored)
+with open(".netrc", "w") as f:
+    f.write("host: example.com\n    :password\n")
+print(f"Test 3 (empty entry): {get_netrc_auth('http://example.com')}")
+# Expected: None
